bestRecentMirrorMomentsShownCount: {count} recent mirror {count, plural, one {moment} other {moments}} shown.
generatedFieldCounts: {sourceCount} {sourceCount, plural, one {source} other {sources}}; {fieldCount} generated {fieldCount, plural, one {field} other {fields}}
loginSubtitle: Sign in to return to what you kept.
signupSubtitle: Keep what moves you, and WAKA works out what you keep returning to.
loginTabContinueAria: continue — sign in to an archive you already have
loginPasswordMin: Password must be at least {count} characters
loginNetworkError: We couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
loginNoResetYet: WAKA cannot reset a password yet. If this address is also your Google address, Continue with Google opens the same archive.
loginUnavailable: Sign-in is not available yet. Create an account instead.
oauthDenied: Google sign-in was cancelled. Try again or use email and password.
oauthExpired: That sign-in link expired. Click “Continue with Google” again.
oauthMismatch: Sign-in could not be verified. Start the Google flow again.
oauthMissingCode: Google did not return a sign-in code. Try the Google button again.
oauthExchangeFailed: We couldn’t reach Google. Try again in a moment.
oauthInvalidToken: Google returned an invalid identity token. Try signing in again.
oauthAccountConflict: This email is linked to another Google account. Sign in with email and password.
oauthUpsertFailed: Something went wrong while finishing your account. Try again.
oauthFallback: Google sign-in did not complete. Try again.
onboardingSubtitle: The name it uses when it speaks to you. You can change it whenever you like.
profileNicknameNoSpacesHint: This is how WAKA addresses and shows you. Spaces are okay.
profilePublicHint: Your public handle controls the read-only page at waka.im/@handle.
profilePublicHandleHint: Used only for your public URL, like waka.im/@your-handle. Use 3–24 letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores; no spaces.
profilePublicHandleInvalid: Use 3–24 letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores; no spaces.
profilePublicHandleRequired: Choose a public handle before enabling public sharing.
profilePublicPrivacyHint: When public profile is off, your /@handle page is not visible. Enabling public profile shares your display name and read-only public page; enabling top-of-mind sharing also shares selected top-of-mind notes. Saved inspirations and account actions stay signed-in only.
profileDeleteHint: This permanently deletes your account and saved data for the current user only. Type DELETE to confirm.
profileMemoriesHint: Each memory keeps its own captures, signals, and top of mind. Yours is the human one; an agent memory lets Claude remember its own work alongside you rather than inside your notes.
profileMemoryRemoveConfirm: Remove this memory and everything in it? Its captures, signals, and top of mind all go with it, and this cannot be undone.
profileMemoryKeyFailed: The memory was made, but its key was not — issue one from its wall.
profileMemoryNameRequired: Give the memory a name first.
profileMemoriesError: Your memories could not be loaded.
profileConnectionsHint: Machines currently signed in to this account, and which memory each one acts as. Ending a connection signs that machine out; it cannot be undone, but you can always sign in again.
profileConnectionEndConfirm: End this connection? That machine will be signed out.
profileConnectionEndCurrentConfirm: This is the device you are using. Ending it signs you out here. Continue?
profileConnectionsError: Your connections could not be loaded.
profileKeysHint: Your own key, for your own tools. Put it in an MCP or CLI config and that machine can save inspirations to your memory and read your signals, top of mind, and principles — as you, and nothing more. Revoking one cuts that machine off at its next request.
profileKeyShownOnce: This is the only time it is shown. Close this and it is gone for good.
profileKeyRevokeConfirm: Revoke this key? The machine holding it loses access at its next request. This cannot be undone.
profileKeysError: Your keys could not be loaded.
profileKeysEmpty: Nothing yet. A key lets your own tools keep and recall without signing in each time.
profileKeyConfigHint: It goes in your MCP server’s env, next to the address:
profileAgentKeysHint: The keys your agents' machines hold — each acts as its agent and nothing else. A forgotten key can't be shown again: issue a new one here and revoke the old; the memory itself is never touched.
profileAgentKeysEmpty: No agent holds a key. Issue one from an agent’s wall when a machine should keep memories as it.
profileGrantsHint: A sibling agent is readable only through your grant — one direction, reading only.
profileGrantsNeedTwo: Grants become possible once the account has two agent memories.
profileGrantsEmpty: No doors are open. Each agent reads only its own memory, and yours.
profileReadRecordHint: Who read whose memory, most recent first.
profileReadRecordEmpty: Nothing served yet. The first time a tool reads signals, a top of mind, or principles, it lands here.
profileReadRecordError: The read record could not be loaded.
surfaceUnavailableBody: Something this screen needs never arrived — usually a dropped connection, sometimes a version that changed while you were here. Nothing you kept is affected.
